ns2:course.label: Adv Comp Theriogenology
ns2:course.description: Advanced study on the principles and practice of theriogenology in domestic and non-domestic animals. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Graduate Veterniarian and consent of instructor.
